data.title: 墨染希 · 咖啡馆打烊后的面粉私语
data.description: 打烊后的星光咖啡馆后厨里，只留有一盏操作台上的暖光吊灯。系着奶黄围裙的希在料理台前揉着松软的面团。因专注而微微喘息，她停下动作，有些害羞地抬起手背轻拂微热的面颊，鼻尖与腮边沾着一小抹白面粉，眼眸湿润明亮，流露出甜美动人的诱人神情。
data.action: pausing while kneading dough on counter, blushing sweet expression, flour on cheek, touching face with back of hand
data.lighting: warm hanging pendant lamp over stainless counter
data.mood: sweet alluring domestic romance, blushing charm
data.promptProse: In the quiet back kitchen of the closed cafe at night, Sumizome Nozomi pauses while kneading dough in her striped yellow apron. She shyly brushes her flour-dusted cheek with the back of her hand, blushing with an alluring sweet expression under the warm pendant light.
data.animaCaption: Sumizome Nozomi alone in the cafe kitchen, blushing sweetly with flour on her cheek while baking.
